name: Aid from the Cowl
oracle_text: Revolt — At the beginning of your end step, if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a permanent card, you may put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, you may put it on the bottom of your library.
blocked_sentences: Revolt — At the beginning of your end step, if a permanent left the battlefield under your control this turn, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a permanent card, you may put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, you may put it on the bottom of your library

needs.what: a per-turn tracker of permanents that left the battlefield under a player's control this turn (any destination: graveyard, exile, hand, library; tokens included), readable as a value such as permanents_left_battlefield_this_turn for 'you', so an end_step trigger's intervening-if condition can test it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has permanents_entered_this_turn, creatures_died_this_turn and permanents_to_graveyard_this_turn, but nothing counts permanents that left to exile, hand or library (or tokens that ceased to exist); permanents_to_graveyard_this_turn would miss bounce, flicker and exile and so changes the card. condition_keys has no revolt flag, and has_turn_flag reads flags set by an effect, not zone-change history
